exposure: Inpatient hospital maternity ward (HMW) delivery setting
cohort: 200 pregnant women and new mothers (100 delivering in an inpatient hospital maternity ward and 100 in outhospital maternity clinics) classified as low and medium-risk.
finding: Outpatient care and delivery were associated with significantly higher Optimality Index scores for both intrapartum and neonatal components compared to inpatient hospital deliveries, indicating multiple benefits for mother and newborn.
